name: Resolve the plan's named works before spending topical queries
when: the plan names works (anchors, canon candidates, seeds) and the archive or a lookup can resolve them
shape: title → archive (held identity) → OpenAlex → one plain-title Scholar lookup; then walk citers from the resolved ids
yields: rankable rows and walkable cites_ids at query one; on a Referee-rich topic 201 works resolved, 188 uncharged (neoliberalism run 1)
misses: works the archive never held and OpenAlex mis-titles (comma-titled books needed a guard); generic titles resolve to the wrong work without a surname check
origin: gs_revamp PRs #179/#181/#187 (2026-08-27..29): named-works resolution at execution start, author-surname verification
